summary: RptMnuStudentExpenseClaims is a web user control for generating and displaying student expense claims reports. It interfaces with backend data via stored procedures, provides user input fields for date selection, performs validations, and outputs reports in CSV and HTML.
purpose: To allow authorized users to generate, validate, and view student expense claims within a specified date range, outputting the results as a CSV (Excel-compatible) report and an HTML summary.

fields.description: Calendar open button for start date.

fields.description: Calendar open button for end date.

workflows.name: Generate Student Expense Claims Report
steps: User enters Start Date and End Date.
Validators ensure both dates are entered and correctly formatted.
User clicks the Excel report button.
System retrieves data using stored procedure.
CSV report is generated and HTML summary is built.
If report content exists, it is displayed in HTML panel.

business_rules: Start Date and End Date are required.
Start Date and End Date must match valid date format.
SessionID is required for report generation.
Report is based on stored procedure 'ReportExpenseClaims'.
validations: RequiredFieldValidators for Start Date and End Date.
CustomValidator for additional business logic as needed.
calculations: Date inputs parsed before passing to stored procedure.
Report generation involves CSV output and HTML rendering.
conditions: Only generate report if both dates are valid and provided.
Show HTML report only if report data is available (not empty).

Updates report description and options from CodeLookupCodes.
Integrates with AJAX calendar extenders for date selection.
Registers JavaScript for async and sync postbacks.
